related.note: no has_delete_permission override -> EmployeeStatus, the record protected by the 'exactly one active status per employee' invariant (obsidian-vault Personnel-Records/Decisions.md #Один-активный-статус-на-сотрудника), can be deleted directly from Admin

the governing service path this Admin registration bypasses: approve() creates a scoped EmployeeStatus, checks for existing ACTIVE conflicts, enforces division-of-decision-maker scoping (line ~76) before mutating .status
AuditMiddleware only fires for request.path.startswith('/api/'); Django Admin requests never go through it, so any mutation made via these two admin registrations is entirely unaudited
